description: PROPOSED. Event-completion pass for Finch and Sparrow Games, Kingslayer Games - Fountain Valley, and Cardboard Games after fresh Wizards/EventLink pull. Adds missing current/future WPN-supported Magic events, clarifies Finch's Friday FNM row, retires one unsupported Finch Standard row, refreshes WPN source freshness, and preserves Cardboard's already-cataloged rows. No canonical JSON, app code, schema/auth/RLS, or personal preference changes.
author: Codex Project Steward
